plugin.name: setup
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Set up sync. labs"
  short_description: "Check your account and make your first talking video"
  default_prompt: "Use $setup to get started with sync. labs."
policy:
  allow_implicit_invocation: false

plugin.name: lipsync-video
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Lipsync a video"
  short_description: "Sync a video's lips to new audio, a song or a typed script"
  default_prompt: "Use $lipsync-video to lipsync my video to this new audio."

plugin.name: talking-photo
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Make a photo talk"
  short_description: "Turn a photo or character into a talking video from a script or audio"
  default_prompt: "Use $talking-photo to make this photo say my script."

plugin.name: edit-dialogue
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Fix spoken words"
  short_description: "Change or remove a few words in the speaker's own voice"
  default_prompt: "Use $edit-dialogue to change a word I said in this video."

plugin.name: translate-and-dub
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Translate and dub a video"
  short_description: "Dub a video or social link into another language with matching lips"
  default_prompt: "Use $translate-and-dub to dub this video into Spanish."

plugin.name: speech
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Speech"
  short_description: "Create and review speech audio with Sync"
  default_prompt: "Use $speech to preview this script in an available voice and show me the cost first."

plugin.name: voices
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Voices"
  short_description: "Choose and manage saved voices with Sync"
  default_prompt: "Use $voices to help me choose one of my saved voices."

plugin.name: media
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Media Library"
  short_description: "Upload and manage your media in Sync"
  default_prompt: "Use $media to find my recent video uploads."

plugin.name: projects
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Projects"
  short_description: "Find and organize your projects in Sync"
  default_prompt: "Use $projects to find and organize my Sync projects."

plugin.name: generations
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Generations"
  short_description: "Find results and resume your Sync jobs"
  default_prompt: "Use $generations to check my latest video and give me its result."

plugin.name: account
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Account and Costs"
  short_description: "Check Sync usage, limits and generation costs"
  default_prompt: "Use $account to check my remaining allowance and recent generation costs."

plugin.name: studio
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Embedded Studio"
  short_description: "Navigate and configure embedded Sync Studio"
  default_prompt: "Use $studio to open my selected project in Sync."

plugin.name: transcribe
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Transcription"
  short_description: "Read timed transcripts from supported media"
  default_prompt: "Use $transcribe to get a timed transcript of this video."

plugin.name: troubleshoot
plugin.interfaceYaml:
interface:
  display_name: "Troubleshooting"
  short_description: "Diagnose and recover interrupted Sync work"
  default_prompt: "Use $troubleshoot to help me recover this failed Sync job."
